value.rationale: Sharp identification of the first nonminimal joint time-frequency support level is a natural boundary question following the global minimizer classification. On the smallest squarefree composite cyclic group it reveals a genuine exact hole 7,8, with an attained next level 9, structurally different from the previous four-cycle and odd-prime examples. The finite group size is a limitation but the gap is an exact invariant rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
